candidates.description: This feature vector represents three-digit numeric values with randomized distribution.

This vector activates on tokens containing nasal-velar or nasal-stop syllable endings, specifically featuring the "-ang" or "-ong" rimes across various casing and prefixes.
This feature vector activates on tokens containing the Latin root for green or spring (virencere/virent).
This feature vector represents demonstrative determiners and pronouns across multiple languages, primarily focusing on proximal and distal indicators like "this" and "that."

This feature activates on distinct subword phonemes and name fragments associated with South Asian and Eastern European proper nouns.
